firstYear: A four-year degree in UNSW's Business School. First year is seven introductory information-systems courses and one second-level course, covering how businesses use technology, programming and databases. Years two and three include three industry placements (about 18 months in total), year four is a supervised research thesis, and the co-op scholarship pays a yearly allowance for all four years.
notThis: Not computer science. The focus is how organisations use technology, such as enterprise systems and digital transformation, rather than building software from the ground up. It is also a separate application: as well as UAC, you apply to the UNSW Co-op Program itself, with a questionnaire and interview and a deadline around the end of September in Year 12. Check the current date with UNSW.
